title: GHDL coverage file
description: The coverage file GHDL writes with 'ghdl -r --coverage', version 1.0.0. Reverse-engineered from GHDL's writer 'src/ghdldrv/ghdlcovout.adb' and reader 'src/ghdldrv/ghdlcov.adb'.

testcase.description: Name of the testcase; GHDL writes 'unknown'.

timestamp.description: Time the file was written, UTC, as YYYYMMDDhhmmss.mmm.

outputs.description: The source files with coverage points.

Output.description: A source file: its name, where it was analyzed, its checksum, and the result per line.

file.description: The file's name, as given to the analysis.

dir.description: The directory the file was analyzed in: '.' for the directory GHDL ran in, '' for an absolute file name.

sha1.description: SHA-1 checksum of the file's content.

max-line.description: The last line with a coverage point.

result.description: Per line with a coverage point: 1, if a statement of the line ran, else 0.
